statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Current cash-equity and fresh delayed cross-asset evidence remain two-way after the EIA release; elevated yields and U.S.-Iran tension keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold while current evidence shows meaningful mean reversion; the Beige Book and Broadcom are later conditional checkpoints.
headline: Post-EIA two-way structure keeps Tail in watch
body: The Nasdaq remained near flat in late morning U.S. trading while fresh delayed shared context showed NQ higher and VIX futures lower. A larger-than-expected crude draw produced a muted oil reaction. Rates and U.S.-Iran conflict remain substantial stress amplifiers, but current evidence does not show persistent no-retracement structure.

lookbackSummary: Tail was high during September 1's rate-and-oil selloff, then fell to watch overnight. September 2 alternated between watch and elevated as premarket weakness repeatedly retraced; the 14:00 UTC assessment was WATCH.
outlookSummary: The next major checkpoints are the 18:00 UTC Beige Book and Broadcom's after-close results and 21:00 UTC call. September 3 brings a 12:30 UTC U.S. data/Fed cluster and 14:00 UTC ISM Services; September 4 brings the Employment Situation. Future Tail remains conditional on persistent price structure.

forecast.analysis: If the post-EIA range remains two-way through midday, Tail stays at the low edge of watch; a fresh extreme-holding move with shallow pullbacks would be the contrary signal.
Ahead of the Beige Book, Tail remains watch if yields and Nasdaq fail to align into a persistent move. Rates acceleration with weak retracements would raise the path risk.
The 18:00 UTC Beige Book is a rates catalyst. Elevated Tail is conditional on a persistent yield-driven Nasdaq extension rather than a brief volatility burst.
After the Beige Book, Tail returns to watch if yields stabilize and equities retrace. Sustained cross-asset alignment without meaningful pullbacks would keep risk elevated.
Broadcom's after-close results are a major technology checkpoint. Elevated Tail is conditional on a broad semiconductor and megacap response that persists beyond the initial print.
The 21:00 UTC Broadcom conference call creates a second information wave. Tail is elevated conditionally on guidance-driven continuation with shallow or failed retracements.
In the first post-call hour, Tail stays elevated only if the technology response keeps extending with poor retracement. A two-way reaction would reduce it quickly.
Late U.S. trading shifts back toward watch if Broadcom-related moves fade and rates remain orderly. Persistent closing-range extension would be the contrary case.
Early Asia carries residual headline and post-earnings risk, but Tail stays near watch unless the prior U.S. move extends across futures without meaningful counter-moves.
With no scheduled U.S. catalyst in this hour, Tail is low if futures remain orderly. New geopolitical escalation or one-way follow-through would invalidate that baseline.
Tail remains low under an orderly overnight path; the main conditional risk is an unexpected geopolitical or rates shock that creates persistent extension.
Absent a new catalyst, the base case is normal overnight price discovery with low Tail. Persistent extreme-holding structure would be required for a material increase.
The low-Tail baseline continues if Asian trading stays balanced and cross-assets do not align directionally. Liquidity can still amplify isolated moves without implying Tail.
Tail remains low before Europe if overnight moves continue to retrace. A gap-like directional break into Europe would raise uncertainty and path risk.
The European handoff moves Tail to watch as liquidity rises. Sustained extension across equities, yields and oil would matter more than the size of an initial move.
European cash trading keeps Tail in watch if moves remain two-way. Shallow pullbacks and repeated extension would be the key escalation signal.
Tail stays in watch during the European morning if cross-asset signals remain mixed. Strong directional breadth with persistent NQ extension would raise it.
With U.S. data still several hours away, Tail remains watch if futures retrace and volatility is contained; directional compression breaking one way would raise risk.
The approach to U.S. data keeps Stress elevated but Tail near watch. Event importance alone does not imply mean-reversion failure before the releases print.
The final pre-data hour carries rising event sensitivity. Tail remains watch unless price structure becomes one-way before the 12:30 UTC release cluster.
The 12:30 UTC cluster of trade, productivity, jobless claims and Fed Waller can produce sharp repricing. Elevated Tail is conditional on persistent post-release extension.
After the 12:30 UTC releases, Tail remains elevated only if the first move persists; orderly retracement would reduce it before the ISM Services checkpoint.
ISM Services at 14:00 UTC is the next high-impact checkpoint. Tail is elevated conditionally on a persistent rates-and-Nasdaq response with poor mean reversion.
